description:
USE WHEN asked to explain a crypto-agent concept (what x402 is, how agents hold wallets, what ERC-8004 does) and you want a sourced explainer you can cite. Find slugs with onchain_agent_list_wiki_pages.
NOT FOR a specific project (use onchain_agent_get_resource instead) or how the Sato Score works (use onchain_agent_get_score_methodology).

RETURNS (json): the full wiki page by slug: summary, why it matters, how it works, key components, examples, risks, related resources/pages. A near-miss slug that plainly means a page ("what-are-erc-8004" or the bare "erc-8004" for "what-is-erc-8004") serves that page and says which one in alias_of; when the slug is also a directory listing, also_listing names onchain_agent_get_resource. An unknown slug is an error; the Sato Score has no wiki page, so "what-is-sato-score" is an error that points at onchain_agent_get_score_methodology. Read-only.

Example: { slug: "what-are-mcps" }

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

name: onchain_agent_get_wiki_page
title: Explain a crypto-agent concept
